speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: When I was a girl they rang the bells through this night for the souls. Then it was stopped.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not saying I miss it. My husband has been dead six years at Hallowtide. I boil his ink every Monday by his receipt, which is remembering enough for a Christian woman.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The horn is the old horn, sir. She boils the new on Monday, as she said she would.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: In Ghent we remembered both ways in one street, and it went ill.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have said it. I am not asking you to make a sermon of Ghent.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I am not making one. I am going out by the north door.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: He is gone, mistress. I will clear his place.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: His place can stay empty. Master Thwaite heard him and did not take it up. Nobody is asking the quiet one for a speech.
